justification: The midpoint rung is the geometric rather than arithmetic mean, so each schedule tightens by a constant proportion per decade instead of deferring most of the reduction to one decade.

justification: An emergency price far above any generator's marginal cost, so the solver sheds load only when nothing else will serve it; conventional in capacity expansion models but carrying no citation here.

A tenth of a per cent sits far above the rounding noise of a converged solve and far below any shedding that would change the reported mix, so it separates numerical residue from genuine infeasibility.
